Owner/occupant contact enrichment (skip-trace). Full charge on delivery (stored or live); never charged on no match or provider error.

Model verdict on a listing asking price: great_deal, good_deal, fair_price, above_average, high_price

UAD quality rating Q1 (highest) to Q6 (lowest). Graded by RED Atlas from listing photos and description; where no grade exists it is derived from the listing's price per m2 band.
